description: Gather IP geolocation information of a host’s IP address using the keyless api.ip2location.io API.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IP address to retrieve geolocation information.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: HTTP connection timeout in seconds. Default: 10

examples:
# Retrieve geolocation data of a host's IP address
- name: Get IP geolocation data
  community.general.ip2location_info:
  register: result

- name: Show some information
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ result.ip }} is located in {{ result.country_code }} ({{ result.country_name }})"

return_values.name: record
return_values.description: Dictionary of IP geolocation information for the IP address. Returned: changed

return_values.name: as
return_values.description: Autonomous system (AS) name. Returned: success Sample: "Google LLC"

return_values.name: asn
return_values.description: Autonomous system number (ASN). Returned: success Sample: "15169"

return_values.name: city_name
return_values.description: City name. Returned: success Sample: "Mountain View"

return_values.name: country_code
return_values.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Returned: success Sample: "US"

return_values.name: country_name
return_values.description: Country name based on ISO 3166. Returned: success Sample: "United States of America"

return_values.name: ip
return_values.description: Public IP address of a host. Returned: success Sample: "8.8.8.8"

return_values.name: is_proxy
return_values.description: Whether is a proxy or not. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: latitude
return_values.description: Latitude of the city. Returned: success Sample: 37.386

return_values.name: longitude
return_values.description: Longitude of the city. Returned: success Sample: -122.0838

return_values.name: region_name
return_values.description: State or province name. Returned: success Sample: "California"

return_values.name: time_zone
return_values.description: UTC time zone (with DST supported). Returned: success Sample: "-08:00"
